[View the ADEQ Hourly Forecast for Yuma]
Daily ozone is forecasted to be in the Good AQI range through the week with variation due to cloud cover and stronger winds that will help to limit ozone concentrations.

Hourly

areas.ag: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District
areas.t: Today, light and variable winds throughout much of the day will lead to pollutant accumulation in the Imperial Valley. Furthermore, a temperature inversion during the morning and evening hours will trap pollutants near the ground. However, low pollutant carryover from the weekend will yield high-Goo
